coderabbit_retest_pairs.reason: every corpus item has exactly one finding-bearing CodeRabbit review, so no retest pair exists; CodeRabbit cannot be re-run

agreement.caveat: κ is chance-corrected agreement and is uninformative when one outcome dominates: read it ONLY beside raw agreement and the marginal distribution printed with it. On the pilot data one outcome (confirmed-high) holds ~93% of all verdicts and there is not one refutation, so κ near 0 or undefined is the expected result and says nothing about the verifier's stability.

verifier.population_note: the verifier runs on blocking severity only — a null verification means it never looked, and is excluded from the denominator rather than counted as agreement
